_comment: The market-data licensing register. Every asset here is 'green' — free to display and redistribute commercially, verified against the actual source's terms, not just 'the API has a free tier'. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's market-data table and planning doc §10.1/§1.2 for the full research. Do NOT add NASDAQ, NIFTY, or individual equities here without an explicit licensing decision — CLAUDE.md non-negotiable #4. This file seeds the assets table; asset_prices are populated by the Phase 2+ fetch pipeline, not here.

assets.name: Bitcoin
assets._citation: Binance publishes its own order book on a keyless public endpoint (data-api.binance.vision) — no third-party licence chain.

assets.name: Gold (PAXG)
assets._citation: PAX Gold is 1:1 redeemable for LBMA-grade gold held in Paxos custody; arbitrage holds it to spot. Real-time and 24/7, unlike the LBMA's own twice-daily fix — see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Labeled honestly as tokenised gold, never as 'LBMA Gold'.

assets.name: Euro / US Dollar
assets._citation: ECB reference rates via the Frankfurter API — open, keyless, commercial reuse permitted. Daily reference rate, not an intraday interbank feed; the app must render this with a 'ECB ref, <time>' cadence label (see FreshnessLabel), never as live.

assets.name: WTI Crude Oil
assets._citation: US EIA spot prices — public domain (US Govt work). Daily official spot, not CME intraday futures (which are licensed) — render with an 'EIA daily' cadence label.

_deferred_gap: US macro releases (CPI, jobs, GDP — category J/macroDataRelease) don't fit the
assets/asset_prices shape cleanly: they're periodic index-value releases, not
continuous quotes, and FRED's licence is per-series (public-domain BLS/BEA/Fed
origin only, per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Left out of this seed rather than forced
into the wrong shape — Phase 10 (Market adapter + Markets tab) needs to decide
whether these get a dedicated 'macro_releases' table or reuse assets with a new
'macro' class. Flagged here rather than solved prematurely.
